editorial_program.name: ORGANISER-BOUND-OPERATOR-PAPER-REPAIR-01
editorial_program.note: Documentary only by mission declaration; supplies no scientific evidence in any case.

required_executable_objects.object: exact engine scheduler (discrete X/Y lattice, event order)
required_executable_objects.evidence: 12 substrate packages under edlab/substrates plus 7 further engines enumerated exhaustively; every one is Game of Life, a Boolean network, a continuum PDE field model, or off-lattice Newtonian particles. No integer per-cell particle-count engine exists in any ref or any unreachable object.

required_executable_objects.object: Y diffusion semantics (four ordered sub-shifts, binomial mover count, destination-capacity blocking)
required_executable_objects.evidence: Structural proof: zero occurrences of np.random.binomial / rng.binomial anywhere in the repository, worktree or history. All 69 textual occurrences of 'binomial' are statistical inference (Clopper-Pearson, Beta-Binomial power, exact McNemar). No 'hop', 'sub-shift' or mover-count symbol exists.

required_executable_objects.partial_analogue: edlab/substrates/lattice_bond/instrumentation.py:95 detect_components(), single-linkage over occupied = m >= matter_threshold. This is a continuum component detector on a matter field, not a classifier over Y particle positions. Zero hits for ONE_CENT*, TWO_CENT*, centre_count, centre_class.
P07/P08/P09 source-placement and sink operators act on lattice_bond matter m with mask/track/threshold gates; there is no X species, no birth acceptance, no source-response kernel.

required_executable_objects.evidence: Case-sensitive muX / mu_X: zero real occurrences. The only genuine near-miss is mu_x^q in a face-flux chemical-potential identity, a different quantity.
Zero occurrences of p_hop, p_hop_Y, hop_prob, pHop in any blob, any ref, any untracked file.
No species-suffixed rate constants exist. The repository's rate names are g0 (growth) and k (homogeneous removal).

CORE_RADIUS = 10 at experiments/individuation/directed_causal_pair_phase0_audit.py:25 and directed_causal_pair_phase05_mechanics.py:52; CORE_RADIUS = 10.0 at directed_causal_pair_phase05_reproduce.py:137. This is the core/halo geometry of the lattice_bond individuation experiments. It is not the CORE_R of a two-centre Y/X architecture and cannot be transferred to one.
lattice_bond carries a bounded-matter cap (MMAX) and a periodic square lattice; 'capacity' in P07/P08 denotes throughput capacity. Neither is a destination-occupancy capacity for hopping particles.

Zero occurrences of TAU_SEP or tau_sep. Over forty distinct tau_* / TAU_* symbols exist (TAU, TAU_MAX, tau_sq, tau_iv, tau_feed, tau_on/off, TAU_CONTRAST, TAU_SLOW ...), none of them a separation time; no '= 125' is bound to any separation concept anywhere.

required_executable_objects.object: function threshold: 101 accepted X births per centre over 250 steps
required_executable_objects.evidence: Zero hits for '101 accepted', accepted_births, 'births per', or 250-step birth windows. Sole near-miss: edlab/substrates/reaction_diffusion/engine.py:93 tau_feed: int = 250, a feed-cohort period unrelated to births or centres.
No Y species exists, therefore no Y ledger exists.
